plan.notes: Official Fullerton College Program Pathways Mapper (fullcoll.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (23) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term. The official map also shows 1 advising milestone(s) (e.g. graduation-application reminders); these are not credit-bearing requirements and are not modeled as courses.

courses.title: Choose a course
courses.choice_note: Choose one course from the official map's “Choose a course” list (9 options). Recommended/first option: ACCT 205 F. Map description: Choose a course from the following. Students need to take a minimum of 8 units from the Restricted Elective list. Click on the "Additional Information" link at the top of the page or view the program catalog to view the Restricted Elective list. These courses are "or" courses. (ACCT 295 F or BUS 295 F), (BUS 111F  or BUS 211 F or BUS 211HF), (CIS 100 F or CIS 100HF).
